title: JACoW LaTeX and Annex B editorial rules
description: Initial agent-operational rule pack for JACoW/IPAC papers. Rules preserve source provenance and distinguish deterministic actions from editor judgement.

sources.title: JACoW Writing a paper in LaTeX resources
JACoW MS Word Style Guide, Annex B operational transcription
Style Guide for JACoW Conference Papers (MS Word version)
jacow-paper-formatting skill (team-supplied rule reference and audit script)

rules.title: Use the current JACoW class file
rules.summary: Use the current jacow.cls supplied by JACoW rather than an older distribution copy.

agent_guidance.action: Compare the detected template version with the configured current version and report evidence.
agent_guidance.escalate_when: the source does not expose a version or updating the class could change layout

rules.title: Protect intentional lowercase title text
rules.summary: JACoW title and section commands uppercase their content; preserve intentional lowercase acronyms or units with \NoCaseChange.

agent_guidance.action: Flag only unprotected tokens that must preserve mixed or lowercase rendering, such as acronyms, model names, or units; ordinary source title case is rendered uppercase by the class.
agent_guidance.escalate_when: the agent cannot distinguish a proper noun from ordinary title-case prose

rules.title: Typeset quantities with a non-breaking thin space
rules.summary: Write the number before the unit and separate them with \, or a siunitx quantity command such as \qty or \SI; do not split a quantity across a line break.

agent_guidance.action: Detect adjacent number-unit pairs and validate spacing, order, and unit casing.
agent_guidance.escalate_when: the expression is mathematical, uses an ambiguous symbol, or contains temperature or angle exceptions

rules.title: Use equation-aware references
rules.summary: Prefer \eqref{label} for equation references so numbering is rendered with parentheses.

agent_guidance.action: Identify parenthesized \ref references that target equation labels and offer \eqref as a candidate.
agent_guidance.escalate_when: the label type cannot be determined from the source

rules.title: Maintain a numbered REFERENCES section
rules.summary: References are numbered, begin at one, and are presented under a REFERENCES heading; in-text citations use bracketed ascending numbers.

agent_guidance.action: Check section presence, citation-link integrity, numbering, order, and bracket syntax deterministically.
agent_guidance.escalate_when: renumbering would require changing ambiguous free-text citations

rules.title: Format reference author lists consistently
rules.summary: Use initials and surnames; use a serial comma for three or more authors and et al. for more than six authors.

agent_guidance.action: Validate punctuation and author-count conventions after parsing an author list.
agent_guidance.escalate_when: author boundaries or the intended author roster are uncertain

rules.title: Use sentence case for referenced paper titles
rules.summary: Titles of cited papers use sentence case while retaining proper nouns and acronyms.

agent_guidance.action: Use a deterministic title-case heuristic, then request an LLM or editor review only for proposed conversion.
agent_guidance.escalate_when: capitalization could change a proper noun, acronym, chemical name, or product name

rules.title: Require key proceedings fields
rules.summary: Published proceedings references identify Proc. CONF’YY, venue, month and year, and page range; DOI follows when known.

agent_guidance.action: Classify proceedings records and report missing required fields with the parsed evidence.
agent_guidance.escalate_when: venue, date, pages, paper ID, or DOI would need external metadata

rules.title: Normalize DOI presentation without inventing identifiers
rules.summary: When a verified DOI exists, present it as one atomic doi:<identifier> token at the end of the entry; retain a URL only when a DOI is unavailable.

agent_guidance.action: Normalize DOI prefixes and DOI URLs; use lookup results only when provenance and title/author matching are recorded.
agent_guidance.escalate_when: a DOI is missing, lookup candidates disagree, or the reference identity is uncertain

rules.title: Prefer BibLaTeX/Biber for generated bibliographies
rules.summary: JACoW guidance recommends BibLaTeX with BibTeX or Biber when its generated bibliography can achieve the requested formatting.

agent_guidance.action: Detect bibliography mode and explain the benefits and migration impact of BibLaTeX.
agent_guidance.escalate_when: migration would require changing a submission's bibliography workflow

rules.title: Use ISO-4 journal abbreviations
rules.summary: Use ISO-4 journal abbreviations and, for BibLaTeX data, keep the abbreviated form in shortjournal where appropriate.

agent_guidance.action: Normalize only when an authoritative abbreviation mapping is available and retain the original title as evidence.
agent_guidance.escalate_when: multiple journals share a similar title or no authoritative mapping is available

rules.title: Use the JACoW page size and margins, without page numbers
rules.summary: Pages are 595 x 792 pt; margins are 19 mm top and bottom and 20 mm left and right; papers carry no page numbers.

agent_guidance.action: Measure page size, the extent of text and images, and lone numbers in the head or foot of each page of the author's PDF (PDF-SIZE-01, PDF-MARGIN-01, PDF-PAGENUM-01).
agent_guidance.escalate_when: the PDF cannot be read, which is reported as NOT CHECKED (PDF-00)

rules.title: Embed every font and avoid bitmap fonts
rules.summary: All fonts, including those inside figures, are embedded; Type 3 bitmap fonts are avoided.

agent_guidance.action: Inspect the fonts used on each page and inside figure form objects (PDF-FONT-01, PDF-FONT-02).
agent_guidance.escalate_when: a font is listed but draws no glyphs

rules.title: Hyperlink DOIs only
rules.summary: DOIs are hyperlinked; other URLs may appear as plain text but must not be hyperlinked.

agent_guidance.action: List web hyperlinks in the author's PDF that do not point to doi.org (PDF-LINK-01), and DOIs split across two lines (PDF-DOI-01).
agent_guidance.escalate_when: the link is part of a figure or an author e-mail address

rules.title: Cite figures, tables and equations in the JACoW forms; keep the abstract free of citations
rules.summary: Fig. 1 mid-sentence and Figure 1 at the start of a sentence; Table 1 is never abbreviated; Eq. (1) mid-sentence; the abstract cites no references.

agent_guidance.action: Match callouts in the body text and citations in the abstract (TXT-CITE-01, TXT-TAB-01, TXT-FIG-01, TXT-EQ-01, TXT-ABS-01).
agent_guidance.escalate_when: the match sits inside a quotation, code or a figure label

rules.title: Cite unpublished and submitted papers in their Annex B forms
rules.summary: An unpublished paper is 'presented at …, unpublished' without 'in Proc.'; a submitted paper does not name the journal; papers with more than six authors use 'et al.'.

agent_guidance.action: Reformat through the reference formatter (Word and \bibitem references, FMT-REF-01, FMT-REF-02 and FMT-REF-03), and match the unpublished and submitted forms in .bib-driven references (REF-FORM-01, REF-FORM-02).
agent_guidance.escalate_when: the reference type is ambiguous

rules.title: Title in capitals, authors as initials and surnames, units joined by a non-breaking space
rules.summary: The title is 14 pt bold uppercase, keeping the case of units and names (GeV, SwissFEL); authors are 'Initials Surname' separated by commas; a non-breaking space precedes each unit, written with its standard symbol.

agent_guidance.action: Read the title, author line and body paragraphs of the Word file (FMT-TITLE-02, WORD-TITLE-01, FMT-AUTH-01, WORD-AUTH-02, WORD-UNIT-01, WORD-UNIT-02).
agent_guidance.escalate_when: a unit spelling is ambiguous (mV/MV, mT/MT), which is never case-corrected

rules.title: Every reference exists and its DOI is its own
rules.summary: A cited DOI must resolve to the cited work; a reference no index carries is checked by hand. Unconfirmed references are normal for theses and reports.

agent_guidance.action: Report the reference formatter's integrity verdict for each reference (REF-INT-01 doi_mismatch, REF-INT-02 suspected_fabricated, REF-INT-03 unverifiable, the last only when lookups ran).
agent_guidance.escalate_when: always, for doi_mismatch and suspected_fabricated

rules.title: Main text of Word papers: headings, captions, callouts, units, acronyms
rules.summary: Unnumbered headings, Title Case subsections, 'Figure 1:' captions ending with a full stop, heading-style table captions without one, callouts and units as in the LaTeX rules, acronyms expanded at first use.

agent_guidance.action: Write mechanical fixes as tracked changes (WORD-UNIT-01, TXT-CITE-01, TXT-TAB-01, TXT-FIG-01 automatically; WORD-UNIT-02, TXT-EQ-01, WORD-TITLE-01, WORD-HEAD-01, WORD-HEAD-02, WORD-CAP-01, WORD-CAP-02, WORD-CAP-03 as suggestions) and report WORD-STYLE-01 and TXT-ACR-01.
agent_guidance.escalate_when: the paragraph contains a hyperlink, field, equation or tracked change; it is then reported, never rewritten

rules.title: Paragraph and heading layout in Word
rules.summary: Body paragraphs 10 pt, justified, first line indented 0.33 cm, widow/orphan control on; subsection headings 12 pt italic, left aligned; no column break after a heading; third-level headings run in.

agent_guidance.action: Tracked formatting changes: WORD-PARA-01, WORD-PARA-02 and WORD-HEAD-03 automatically; WORD-PARA-03, WORD-PARA-04 and WORD-HEAD-05 as suggestions. Report WORD-HEAD-04 and the skill audit (WORD-LAYOUT-01, WORD-FONT-01, WORD-LINK-01, WORD-REFSPACE-01 and others).
agent_guidance.escalate_when: the paragraph is a caption, list item or equation

common_editor_decisions.policy: Missing authors, dates, venue, pages, paper IDs, and DOI values require an evidence-backed lookup or human review.

common_editor_decisions.decision: Deterministic evidence overrides an unsupported model suggestion.
common_editor_decisions.policy: The agent may propose an LLM-assisted repair only when it cites the applicable rule and source evidence; otherwise leave it pending editor review.

common_editor_decisions.decision: Only retain repairs that preserve build validity.
common_editor_decisions.policy: A repair batch remains pending until the edited source is compiled when compilation is available; compile failures must be surfaced with the repair evidence.

extension_guide.add_a_version: Copy this file to the next semantic version, retain prior rule IDs when their meaning is unchanged, and add source provenance for every changed rule.
extension_guide.add_a_rule: Use a stable ID, narrow applicability, an operational summary, deterministic action guidance, automation policy, escalation condition, and source IDs.
extension_guide.avoid: Do not store unsourced model advice as a rule or convert editor decisions into automatic fixes without validation.
